hero.title: Quiet software for *loud* weeks.
hero.lede: Quietly folds your calendar, inbox and to-dos into one calm page each morning. It decides what can wait, so you can do the one thing that can’t.

form.success: You’re on the list. Invites go out on Mondays; yours will come from hello@quietly.example.

hero.note: Invites go out every Monday. One email, no newsletter.

columns.title: One page, every morning.
columns.text: Meetings, replies and tasks arrive as a single ruled page you can read in ninety seconds.

columns.title: Silence by default.
columns.text: Notifications wait in a tray until the hour you chose. The people you mark as urgent can still reach you.

columns.title: Friday, on paper.
columns.text: A printable summary of what moved, what stalled and what you can drop next week.

features.title: Everything that matters today, and *nothing* else.
features.text: Quietly reads your calendar and inbox overnight, sorts by what needs you, and sets the rest aside in a tray you can open whenever you like.

features.title: Fewer pings. Longer mornings.
features.text:
Most tools compete for your attention. Quietly is built to give it back: it has no badges, no streaks and no red dots, and it never sends a notification you didn’t ask for.

When something truly can’t wait, it reaches you once, in plain words, and then leaves you alone.
points: No unread counts, anywhere in the app
Quiet hours on by default, from 9 to 12
Urgent people and threads break through, nothing else
Your data stays yours: export everything as plain text

quote.text: The first tool in years that made my week feel smaller instead of bigger.

items.q: Which calendars and inboxes does it work with?
items.a: Google Calendar, Gmail, Outlook and any IMAP inbox in the beta. iCloud is next.
Only on your device. Sorting happens in the app; the server only ever sees the times of your meetings, never their contents or your messages.
Free during the beta. After that, $6 a month or $60 a year, and beta readers keep half price for life.
Every Monday, in the order people joined the list. You’ll get one email with your invite, and nothing before it.

closing.title: Make next week *quieter*.
closing.text: Join the list and we’ll send one email when your invite is ready.
